species.description: Wandering souls gathered together to form this Pokémon. When trying to make friends with children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.

species.name: Drifblim
species.description: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s thought to carry away people and Pokémon.

species.name: Buneary
species.description: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked by an enemy.

species.name: Lopunny
species.description: It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

species.name: Mismagius
species.description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

species.name: Glameow
species.description: When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

species.name: Purugly
species.description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

species.name: Chingling
species.description: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

species.name: Stunky
species.description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

species.name: Skuntank
species.description: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

species.name: Bronzor
species.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

species.name: Bronzong
species.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

species.name: Bonsly
species.description: If its body gets too damp, it will die. So, in a process reminiscent of sweating, its eyes expel moisture.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.description: When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent, Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up forgetting it was imitating something.

species.name: Happiny
species.description: When it sees something round and white, Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It sometimes becomes overloaded and can’t move.

species.name: Chatot
species.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.description: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

species.name: Gible
species.description: Its original home is an area much hotter than Alola. If you’re planning to live with one, your heating bill will soar.

species.name: Gabite
species.description: It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.

species.name: Garchomp
species.description: Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.

species.name: Munchlax
species.description: Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.

species.name: Riolu
species.description: It uses waves called auras to communicate with others of its kind. It doesn’t make any noise during this time, so its enemies can’t detect it.

species.name: Lucario
species.description: Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

species.name: Skorupi
species.description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

species.name: Drapion
species.description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

species.name: Croagunk
species.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

species.name: Carnivine
species.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

species.name: Finneon
species.description: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

species.name: Lumineon
species.description: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

species.name: Mantyke
species.description: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.

species.name: Snover
species.description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

species.name: Weavile
species.description: Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!

species.name: Magnezone
species.description: There are still people who believe that this Pokémon came from outer space. It emanates a powerful magnetic field.

species.name: Lickilicky
species.description: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.

species.name: Electivire
species.description: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

species.name: Magmortar
species.description: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

species.name: Togekiss
species.description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.

species.name: Yanmega
species.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

species.name: Leafeon
species.description: It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives a quiet life deep in forests where clean rivers flow.

species.name: Glaceon
species.description: It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.

species.name: Gliscor
species.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

species.name: Mamoswine
species.description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.description: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.

species.name: Gallade
species.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

species.name: Probopass
species.description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

species.name: Froslass
species.description: It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!

species.name: Rotom
species.description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Uxie
species.description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

species.name: Mesprit
species.description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.

species.name: Azelf
species.description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

species.name: Dialga
species.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

species.name: Palkia
species.description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

species.name: Heatran
species.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

species.name: Regigigas
species.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

species.name: Giratina
species.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

species.name: Cresselia
species.description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

species.name: Manaphy
species.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: Darkrai
species.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

species.name: Shaymin
species.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

species.name: Arceus
species.description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

species.name: Victini
species.description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

species.name: Snivy
species.description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

species.name: Servine
species.description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

species.name: Serperior
species.description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

species.name: Tepig
species.description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

species.name: Pignite
species.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

species.name: Emboar
species.description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

species.name: Oshawott
species.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

species.name: Dewott
species.description: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

species.name: Samurott
species.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

species.name: Patrat
species.description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

species.name: Watchog
species.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

species.name: Lillipup
species.description: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s commands, and easy to raise.

species.name: Herdier
species.description: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

species.name: Stoutland
species.description: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

species.name: Purrloin
species.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

species.name: Liepard
species.description: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

species.name: Pansage
species.description: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

species.name: Simisage
species.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

species.name: Pansear
species.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Simisear
species.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

species.name: Panpour
species.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

species.name: Simipour
species.description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

species.name: Munna
species.description: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

species.name: Musharna
species.description: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

species.name: Pidove
species.description: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

species.name: Tranquill
species.description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

species.name: Unfezant
species.description: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

species.name: Blitzle
species.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

species.name: Zebstrika
species.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

species.name: Roggenrola
species.description: It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.

species.name: Boldore
species.description: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They’re valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.

species.name: Gigalith
species.description: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath the surface.

species.name: Woobat
species.description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

species.name: Swoobat
species.description: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

species.name: Drilbur
species.description: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

species.name: Excadrill
species.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

species.name: Audino
species.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

species.name: Timburr
species.description: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

species.name: Gurdurr
species.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

species.name: Conkeldurr
species.description: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

species.name: Tympole
species.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

species.name: Palpitoad
species.description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

species.name: Seismitoad
species.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

species.name: Throh
species.description: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

species.name: Sawk
species.description: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

species.name: Sewaddle
species.description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

species.name: Swadloon
species.description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

species.name: Leavanny
species.description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

species.name: Venipede
species.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

species.name: Whirlipede
species.description: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

species.name: Scolipede
species.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

species.name: Cottonee
species.description: When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.

species.name: Whimsicott
species.description: Whimsicott doesn’t live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.

species.name: Petilil
species.description: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

species.name: Lilligant
species.description: It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

species.name: Basculin
species.description: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That’s how violent Basculin are.

species.name: Sandile
species.description: Sandile’s still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It’s called “the cleaner of the desert.”

species.name: Krokorok
species.description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

species.name: Krookodile
species.description: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

species.name: Darumaka
species.description: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Darmanitan
species.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

species.name: Maractus
species.description: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

species.name: Dwebble
species.description: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

species.name: Crustle
species.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

species.name: Scraggy
species.description: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.

species.name: Scrafty
species.description: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.

species.name: Sigilyph
species.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

species.name: Yamask
species.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

species.name: Cofagrigus
species.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

species.name: Tirtouga
species.description: Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.

species.name: Carracosta
species.description: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.

species.name: Archen
species.description: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.

species.name: Archeops
species.description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

species.name: Trubbish
species.description: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.

species.name: Garbodor
species.description: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.

species.name: Zorua
species.description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

species.name: Zoroark
species.description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

species.name: Minccino
species.description: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.

species.name: Cinccino
species.description: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

species.name: Gothita
species.description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

species.name: Gothorita
species.description: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

species.name: Gothitelle
species.description: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.

species.name: Solosis
species.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

species.name: Duosion
species.description: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

species.name: Reuniclus
species.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

species.name: Ducklett
species.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

species.name: Swanna
species.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

species.name: Vanillite
species.description: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.

species.name: Vanillish
species.description: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.

species.name: Vanilluxe
species.description: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day’s light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.

species.name: Deerling
species.description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

species.name: Sawsbuck
species.description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

species.name: Emolga
species.description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

species.name: Karrablast
species.description: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

species.name: Escavalier
species.description: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

species.name: Foongus
species.description: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.

species.name: Amoonguss
species.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

species.name: Frillish
species.description: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.

species.name: Jellicent
species.description: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It’s rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.

species.name: Alomomola
species.description: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

species.name: Joltik
species.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

species.name: Galvantula
species.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

species.name: Ferroseed
species.description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

species.name: Ferrothorn
species.description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

species.name: Klink
species.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

species.name: Klang
species.description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.

species.name: Klinklang
species.description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

species.name: Tynamo
species.description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

species.name: Eelektrik
species.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

species.name: Eelektross
species.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

species.name: Elgyem
species.description: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It’s said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.

species.name: Beheeyem
species.description: It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.

species.name: Litwick
species.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

species.name: Lampent
species.description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

species.name: Chandelure
species.description: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

species.name: Axew
species.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

species.name: Fraxure
species.description: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

species.name: Haxorus
species.description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

species.name: Cubchoo
species.description: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

species.name: Beartic
species.description: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

species.name: Cryogonal
species.description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Shelmet
species.description: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

species.name: Accelgor
species.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

species.name: Stunfisk
species.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

species.name: Mienfoo
species.description: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

species.name: Mienshao
species.description: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

species.name: Druddigon
species.description: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.

species.name: Golett
species.description: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.

species.name: Golurk
species.description: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.

species.name: Pawniard
species.description: It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.

species.name: Bisharp
species.description: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn’t even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.

species.name: Bouffalant
species.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

species.name: Rufflet
species.description: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.

species.name: Braviary
species.description: Known as “the hero of the skies,” this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it’s injured.

species.name: Vullaby
species.description: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

species.name: Mandibuzz
species.description: It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.

species.name: Heatmor
species.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

species.name: Durant
species.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

species.name: Deino
species.description: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

species.name: Zweilous
species.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

species.name: Hydreigon
species.description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

species.name: Larvesta
species.description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

species.name: Volcarona
species.description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

species.name: Cobalion
species.description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

species.name: Terrakion
species.description: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

species.name: Virizion
species.description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

species.name: Tornadus
species.description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

species.name: Thundurus
species.description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

species.name: Reshiram
species.description: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

species.name: Zekrom
species.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

species.name: Landorus
species.description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

species.name: Kyurem
species.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

species.name: Keldeo
species.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

species.name: Meloetta
species.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

species.name: Genesect
species.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

species.name: Chespin
species.description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

species.name: Quilladin
species.description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

species.name: Chesnaught
species.description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

species.name: Fennekin
species.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

species.name: Braixen
species.description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

species.name: Delphox
species.description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

species.name: Froakie
species.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

species.name: Frogadier
species.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

species.name: Greninja
species.description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

species.name: Bunnelby
species.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

species.name: Diggersby
species.description: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.

species.name: Fletchling
species.description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

species.name: Fletchinder
species.description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

species.name: Talonflame
species.description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

species.name: Scatterbug
species.description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

species.name: Spewpa
species.description: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

species.name: Vivillon
species.description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

species.name: Litleo
species.description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

species.name: Pyroar
species.description: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

species.name: Flabébé
species.description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

species.name: Floette
species.description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

species.name: Florges
species.description: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

species.name: Skiddo
species.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

species.name: Gogoat
species.description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

species.name: Pancham
species.description: It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.

species.name: Pangoro
species.description: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.

species.name: Furfrou
species.description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

species.name: Espurr
species.description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

species.name: Meowstic
species.description: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

species.name: Honedge
species.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.

species.name: Doublade
species.description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

species.name: Aegislash
species.description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

species.name: Spritzee
species.description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

species.name: Aromatisse
species.description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

species.name: Swirlix
species.description: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.

species.name: Slurpuff
species.description: Its sense of smell is 100 million times better than a human’s, so even the faintest scent tells it about everything in the area. It’s like it can see with its nose!

species.name: Inkay
species.description: When exchanging information with others of its kind, it flashes the light-emitting spots on its body in a complex rhythm.

species.name: Malamar
species.description: It flashes the pattern on its torso to control its prey and draw them in. The edges of its fins are supremely sharp.

species.name: Binacle
species.description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

species.name: Barbaracle
species.description: Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head’s orders.

species.name: Skrelp
species.description: It’s not good at swimming, so it clings to the seaweed. In the Alola region, it’s often found near Dhelmise.

species.name: Dragalge
species.description: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.

species.name: Clauncher
species.description: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it’s terrible at swimming straight.

species.name: Clawitzer
species.description: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it’s exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

species.name: Helioptile
species.description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

species.name: Heliolisk
species.description: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

species.name: Tyrunt
species.description: Tyrunt is spoiled and selfish. It may just be trying to frolic, but sometimes the ones it’s trying to frolic with are gravely injured.

species.name: Tyrantrum
species.description: The king of the ancient world, it can easily crunch a car with the devastating strength of its enormous jaws.

species.name: Amaura
species.description: Amaura was restored successfully, but it’s not expected to live long because of the heat of the current environment.

species.name: Aurorus
species.description: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around –240 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Sylveon
species.description: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer’s arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer’s feelings.

species.name: Hawlucha
species.description: In combat, Hawlucha leaps nimbly about, taking advantage of its opponents’ blind spots. It’s also skilled at using superb submission holds.

species.name: Dedenne
species.description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

species.name: Carbink
species.description: To keep the jewels on their bodies free of tarnish, packs of Carbink use their soft manes to polish one another’s jewels.

species.name: Goomy
species.description: Its body is mostly water. If it dries out, it will die, so it’s always sitting with perfect stillness in the shade.

species.name: Sliggoo
species.description: Its entire body is covered with gooey mucus that can dissolve anything. Be sure to put gloves on if you’re going to touch it.

species.name: Goodra
species.description: Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat, and the combination of the two makes enemies’ attacks slide right off.

species.name: Klefki
species.description: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

species.name: Phantump
species.description: An unknown spirit came to lodge in a tree stump, creating this Pokémon. A cure-all can be made from an infusion of its green leaves.

species.name: Trevenant
species.description: This Pokémon controls trees via roots stretching from its feet, and it will attack anyone that dares to ravage the forest.

species.name: Pumpkaboo
species.description: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.

species.name: Gourgeist
species.description: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.

species.name: Bergmite
species.description: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

species.name: Avalugg
species.description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

species.name: Noibat
species.description: It flies around in search of fruit to eat. It uses ultrasonic waves to detect which fruits are ripe.

species.name: Noivern
species.description: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.

species.name: Xerneas
species.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

species.name: Yveltal
species.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

species.name: Zygarde
species.description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

species.name: Diancie
species.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

species.name: Hoopa
species.description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

species.name: Volcanion
species.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

species.name: Rowlet
species.description: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag as a nest.

species.name: Dartrix
species.description: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

species.name: Decidueye
species.description: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.

species.name: Litten
species.description: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

species.name: Torracat
species.description: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it’s feeling good. When it isn’t feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

species.name: Incineroar
species.description: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

species.name: Popplio
species.description: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It’s quite the acrobatic fighter!

species.name: Brionne
species.description: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.

species.name: Primarina
species.description: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.

species.name: Pikipek
species.description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

species.name: Trumbeak
species.description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

species.name: Toucannon
species.description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

species.name: Yungoos
species.description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

species.name: Gumshoos
species.description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

species.name: Grubbin
species.description: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.

species.name: Charjabug
species.description: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.

species.name: Vikavolt
species.description: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.

species.name: Crabrawler
species.description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

species.name: Crabominable
species.description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

species.name: Oricorio
species.description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

species.name: Cutiefly
species.description: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes’ movements and make fools of them.

species.name: Ribombee
species.description: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.

species.name: Rockruff
species.description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

species.name: Lycanroc
species.description: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

species.name: Wishiwashi
species.description: When it’s in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.

species.name: Mareanie
species.description: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they’re cut off. After a good night’s sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.

species.name: Toxapex
species.description: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn’t affect Toxapex in there, so it’s very comfortable.

species.name: Mudbray
species.description: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.

species.name: Mudsdale
species.description: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.

species.name: Dewpider
species.description: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.

species.name: Araquanid
species.description: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn’t watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!

species.name: Fomantis
species.description: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

species.name: Lurantis
species.description: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it’s dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

species.name: Morelull
species.description: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

species.name: Shiinotic
species.description: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!

species.name: Salandit
species.description: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn’t deal well with Spinda, since it’s always reeling.

species.name: Salazzle
species.description: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

species.name: Stufful
species.description: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.

species.name: Bewear
species.description: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.

species.name: Bounsweet
species.description: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It’s usually a fruitless attempt.

species.name: Steenee
species.description: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They’re quite painful when they smack you!

species.name: Tsareena
species.description: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.

species.name: Comfey
species.description: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.

species.name: Oranguru
species.description: Oranguru don’t get along with each other, so they’re always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.

species.name: Passimian
species.description: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.

species.name: Wimpod
species.description: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.

species.name: Golisopod
species.description: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.

species.name: Sandygast
species.description: If you build sand mounds when you’re playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

species.name: Palossand
species.description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

species.name: Pyukumuku
species.description: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!

species.name: Type: Null
species.description: There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.

species.name: Silvally
species.description: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.

species.name: Minior
species.description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

species.name: Komala
species.description: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

species.name: Turtonator
species.description: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.

species.name: Togedemaru
species.description: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!

species.name: Mimikyu
species.description: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

species.name: Bruxish
species.description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

species.name: Drampa
species.description: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger, so their moms don’t have to worry.

species.name: Dhelmise
species.description: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.

species.name: Jangmo-o
species.description: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.

species.name: Hakamo-o
species.description: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they’re a popular item.

species.name: Kommo-o
species.description: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.

species.name: Tapu Koko
species.description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

species.name: Tapu Lele
species.description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

species.name: Tapu Bulu
species.description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

species.name: Tapu Fini
species.description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

species.name: Cosmog
species.description: Whether or not it’s a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it’s in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

species.name: Cosmoem
species.description: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

species.name: Solgaleo
species.description: In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name “the beast that devours the sun.”

species.name: Lunala
species.description: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

species.name: Nihilego
species.description: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

species.name: Buzzwole
species.description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

species.name: Pheromosa
species.description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Xurkitree
species.description: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

species.name: Celesteela
species.description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Kartana
species.description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

species.name: Guzzlord
species.description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

species.name: Necrozma
species.description: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.

species.name: Magearna
species.description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

species.name: Marshadow
species.description: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

species.name: Poipole
species.description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

species.name: Naganadel
species.description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

species.name: Stakataka
species.description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

species.name: Blacephalon
species.description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

species.name: Zeraora
species.description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

species.name: Meltan
species.description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

species.name: Melmetal
species.description: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

species.name: Grookey
species.description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

species.name: Thwackey
species.description: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

species.name: Rillaboom
species.description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

species.name: Scorbunny
species.description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

species.name: Raboot
species.description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

species.name: Cinderace
species.description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

species.name: Sobble
species.description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

species.name: Drizzile
species.description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

species.name: Inteleon
species.description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

species.name: Skwovet
species.description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

species.name: Greedent
species.description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

species.name: Rookidee
species.description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

species.name: Corvisquire
species.description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

species.name: Corviknight
species.description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

species.name: Blipbug
species.description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

species.name: Dottler
species.description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

species.name: Orbeetle
species.description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

species.name: Nickit
species.description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

species.name: Thievul
species.description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

species.name: Gossifleur
species.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

species.name: Eldegoss
species.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

species.name: Wooloo
species.description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

species.name: Dubwool
species.description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

species.name: Chewtle
species.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

species.name: Drednaw
species.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

species.name: Yamper
species.description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

species.name: Boltund
species.description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

species.name: Rolycoly
species.description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

species.name: Carkol
species.description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Coalossal
species.description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

species.name: Applin
species.description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

species.name: Flapple
species.description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

species.name: Appletun
species.description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

species.name: Silicobra
species.description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

species.name: Sandaconda
species.description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

species.name: Cramorant
species.description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

species.name: Arrokuda
species.description: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

species.name: Barraskewda
species.description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

species.name: Toxel
species.description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

species.name: Toxtricity
species.description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

species.name: Sizzlipede
species.description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

species.name: Centiskorch
species.description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

species.name: Clobbopus
species.description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

species.name: Grapploct
species.description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

species.name: Sinistea
species.description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

species.name: Polteageist
species.description: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

species.name: Hatenna
species.description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

species.name: Hattrem
species.description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

species.name: Hatterene
species.description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

species.name: Impidimp
species.description: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

species.name: Morgrem
species.description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

species.name: Grimmsnarl
species.description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

species.name: Obstagoon
species.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

species.name: Perrserker
species.description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

species.name: Cursola
species.description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

species.name: Sirfetch’d
species.description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

species.name: Mr. Rime
species.description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

species.name: Runerigus
species.description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

species.name: Milcery
species.description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

species.name: Alcremie
species.description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

species.name: Falinks
species.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

species.name: Pincurchin
species.description: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

species.name: Snom
species.description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

species.name: Frosmoth
species.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

species.name: Stonjourner
species.description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

species.name: Eiscue
species.description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

species.name: Indeedee
species.description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

species.name: Morpeko
species.description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

species.name: Cufant
species.description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

species.name: Copperajah
species.description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

species.name: Dracozolt
species.description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

species.name: Arctozolt
species.description: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

species.name: Dracovish
species.description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

species.name: Arctovish
species.description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

species.name: Duraludon
species.description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

species.name: Dreepy
species.description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

species.name: Drakloak
species.description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

species.name: Dragapult
species.description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

species.name: Zacian
species.description: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

species.name: Zamazenta
species.description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

species.name: Eternatus
species.description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

species.name: Kubfu
species.description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

species.name: Urshifu
species.description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

species.name: Zarude
species.description: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

species.name: Regieleki
species.description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

species.name: Regidrago
species.description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

species.name: Glastrier
species.description: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

species.name: Spectrier
species.description: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

species.name: Calyrex
species.description: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

species.name: Wyrdeer
species.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

species.name: Kleavor
species.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

species.name: Ursaluna
species.description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

species.name: Basculegion
species.description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

species.name: Sneasler
species.description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

species.name: Overqwil
species.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

species.name: Enamorus
species.description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

species.name: Sprigatito
species.description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

species.name: Floragato
species.description: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

species.name: Meowscarada
species.description: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

species.name: Fuecoco
species.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

species.name: Crocalor
species.description: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

species.name: Skeledirge
species.description: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Quaxly
species.description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

species.name: Quaxwell
species.description: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

species.name: Quaquaval
species.description: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

species.name: Lechonk
species.description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

species.name: Oinkologne
species.description: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

species.name: Tarountula
species.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

species.name: Spidops
species.description: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

species.name: Nymble
species.description: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

species.name: Lokix
species.description: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

species.name: Pawmi
species.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
